decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf is a low-cost extension of the heritage bread line, and management has already justified keeping it, so it stays despite the lack of recent evidence.

The mill tour builds on sunk investments in hospitality facilities and showcases the firm's tradition; pandemic-related weakness in 2020-2021 is easily attributed to temporary causes, so management persists.
The crusty farmhouse bread sits close to the core assortment and costs little to maintain, so there is no pressing reason to withdraw it.
The poppy seed stollen is the publicly presented flagship with its own page and a gold award, so commitment and justification pressures make dropping it very unlikely.
The award-winning premium stollen supports the firm's festive quality image and the Christmas line it has visibly committed to, so management keeps it.
